'''Rether''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Outpost Skyline]] on [[Voss]], where he sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
